extraction_notes: Catalytic-performance values are reported mainly as bar/point plots in Figures 6 and 7; nonprinted values were read approximately from the plotted axes and marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 3 data for neat In2O3 and In(OH)3 were not extracted because the text states those catalytic activity data were already measured in a previous study and only used here as a benchmark. In situ XRD/TGA phase-transition plots were not extracted as catalyst-performance records.
